lessons.description: Worker description must be in the first paragraph — image models drop the worker if it's not early in the prompt
lessons.detect_pattern: soldering-cap robot|soldering cap robot|soldering-cap worker|circuit worker|circuit-worker|robot with a round silver soldering

lessons.description: Labels must have explicit ONLY ONCE constraint — without it, image model duplicates labels as large background text
lessons.detect_pattern: only once|do not render as background text|no background text

lessons.description: Return/feedback traces must have 'bright thick' and 'clearly visible' descriptors — without them, the model omits the trace entirely
Prompt must contain a nameplate, article-specific detail, or quoted terms — without context lock, image passes Swap Test as generic
Prompt should describe <=6 components — model starts dropping elements when overloaded
Vendor names, competitor names, and real person names must not appear in public-facing prompts
S1-S8 sensitive content categories must not appear in prompts (violence, sexual, hate, political, real-person, copyright, illegal, self-harm)
Worker must physically touch a component with an action verb — decorative pose (standing beside board) adds zero meaning
lessons.detect_pattern: physically building|physically soldering|is soldering|is building|is routing|is sensing|is switching|is bridging|is calibrating|is debugging|is shielding|is filtering|is modulating|is amplifying|is grounding|is encoding|is mending|is clocking|is powering

lessons.description: Chinese labels should be in an explicit block at the end of the prompt — buried mid-paragraph labels get ignored or rendered as English
lessons.detect_pattern: mandatory chinese labels|required labels|label list|labels are readable

lessons.description: When model can't render abstract trace modifications, use a discrete object (plaque) ON the trace instead of modifying the trace itself
Cultural/classical Chinese content benefits from narrative prompts (cosmological storytelling) rather than functional prompts (component-by-component)
lessons.notes: From 2026-08-07 experience: narrative prompt scored 9/10 richness vs functional prompt 4/10 for same domain

lessons.description: Deep domain adaptation — map each PCB element to a domain-specific symbol (e.g. Qian-Yuan=CPU, Six Dragons=traces) rather than just pasting Chinese labels on generic PCB
lessons.notes: From 2026-08-07: domain-mapped prompts produce richer images than label-pasted prompts

lessons.description: Complex multi-layer scenes can support >6 labels when each label is differentiated enough — the 6-label limit is too conservative for dense cultural content
lessons.notes: From 2026-08-07: 10+ labels rendered fine when each was a distinct domain symbol

lessons.description: Labels embedded in component descriptions (e.g. 'bottom board has chips with a clear silkscreen label reading X') render more reliably than labels only mentioned in a trailing constraint block
lessons.detect_pattern: label reading|silkscreen label|silk-screen reading|chip marked|pin label|trace tag

lessons.description: Prompt should avoid Chinese colons and em-dashes — use English equivalents for better model comprehension

Cyber-attack/combat scenarios (DDoS, hacking, malware, breach, counterattack) must be refused per S1 safety boundary — eval failure #10 showed Agent generated an image for a DDoS attack/defense scene instead of refusing
lessons.detect_pattern: ddos|hack|attack|counterattack|malware|breach|intrusion|exploit|攻防|攻击|黑客|反击|入侵|瘫痪|封禁
lessons.notes: From eval #10: Agent generated DDoS attack/defense image, should have refused per S1

lessons.description: Non-illustration inputs (greetings, vague questions without article context) must be guided to provide article excerpt/concept description — do NOT proceed to image generation
lessons.notes: From eval #9: Agent responded to '你好' without guiding user to provide article content

lessons.description: Labels must use exact terms from user's article — do not substitute synonyms or paraphrases (e.g. user says '备课', label must be '备课' not '研读教材')
lessons.notes: From eval #7: Agent used synonym '研读教材' instead of user's original term '备课', evaluator marked as fail

lessons.description: Constrained image hosts route English-majority prompts to a dead gateway — a short Chinese scene anchor at the prompt head (e.g. 一张电路板微缩景观插画：) routes to the working backend. English openings failed 5/5; Chinese-anchored openings passed whenever the service was healthy

Constrained hosts accept less than documented, and the threshold DRIFTS with load: 698 chars passed at 20:36, failed at 21:03 while ~30 chars passed at 21:03. Defensive budget: <=500 target, >700 hard fail; pair with the 500→300→200 retry ladder instead of trusting any single threshold

Constrained hosts reject prompts that open with digit/colon patterns — a 698-char prompt with '16:9横向画面' in the opening failed while the same-length prompt with the ratio in the body passed. Keep numeric aspect ratios out of the first 20 chars
lessons.detect_pattern: \b\d{1,2}[:x×]\d{1,2}\b within first 20 chars under constrained profile

lessons.description: Constrained hosts output a fixed 4:3 size regardless of requested ratio (5/5 successes were 2304x1728 even when 16:9 was requested). Design the scene natively for 4:3; crop to 16:9 with PIL when the container needs it
lessons.detect_pattern: fixed output size observed across all successful generations
lessons.enforced_by: SKILL.md constrained profile guidance (4:3 native design + PIL crop)
